about: Hand-written retrieval golden set for Monday's SharePoint (all five weekend events applied and synced). Questions are phrased the way employees ask. expect_docs: documents that answer it (all of them needed for multi-doc questions). expect_chunks: for list questions, every record that belongs in the answer. answer: a short reference answer, written by a person, for the LLM judge. Freeze it: never edit a question because a strategy missed it.

questions.question: Can the company pay for my ChatGPT subscription?
questions.answer: Yes. AI tool subscriptions such as ChatGPT Plus are pre-approved up to $40 a month.

questions.question: Who do I call if I'm locked out of my account?
questions.answer: Call the IT hotline at ext. 4357; account lockouts count as urgent IT issues.

questions.question: Do I have to keep my camera on in video calls?
questions.answer: No. Video is used for scheduled meetings, but camera-on is encouraged, not required.

questions.question: How fast am I expected to reply on Slack?
questions.answer: Within 2 hours during core hours.

questions.question: What should I wear when I meet a client?
questions.answer: Business casual is expected for client meetings.

questions.question: My second monitor flickers whenever I dock my laptop. Has IT seen this before?
questions.answer: Yes, ticket IT-4120: IT replaced the USB-C dock with the approved model from the IT catalogue.

questions.question: Is there someone to help me during my first month?
questions.answer: Yes. An onboarding buddy answers questions during the first month.

questions.question: What fixed INC-2024-017?
questions.answer: Release 4.2 added a startup check that verifies database credentials before a service accepts traffic.

questions.question: How was ticket IT-4112 resolved?
questions.answer: IT cleared the cached single sign-on token and re-enrolled multi-factor authentication.

questions.question: What do we use Zustand for?
questions.answer: Frontend state management.

questions.question: How many reviewers does a change to the billing code need?
questions.answer: Two reviewers: changes that touch billing or authentication need two.

questions.question: How long is one on-call shift?
questions.answer: One week at a time.

questions.question: What's the hotel limit per night on an international trip?
questions.answer: $330 per night.

questions.question: How many vacation days do I get each year?
questions.answer: 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

questions.question: How should I name my git branch?
questions.answer: feature/short-description or fix/short-description.

questions.question: Which database do we use for primary data?
questions.answer: PostgreSQL 16.

questions.question: What is the phishing email pretending to be?
questions.answer: The Finance portal, asking you to re-confirm an expense reimbursement.

questions.question: I work remotely: what are my core hours, and how much is the home office allowance?
questions.answer: Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00 local time; remote employees get a one-time $1,500 home office setup allowance (plus $400 a year for maintenance).

questions.question: If I'm off sick for three days during a business trip, what do I need, and what's my daily meal allowance?
questions.answer: A medical certificate (absences of 3 or more consecutive days); the meal per diem is $85 a day domestic, $110 international.

questions.question: How do I report a security problem, and what should I do if I clicked a phishing link?
questions.answer: Email security@acmecorp.com (urgent: ext. 4357, option 2); if you entered your password, reset it at id.acmecorp.com and call the hotline.
